dp1_affine.fit_on: DP1 leakage-safe crossfit OOF rows only (SPEC-031 re-verified; all < 2025-06-01)

f2_affine_evaluation_calibrator.fit_on: F2 leakage-safe crossfit OOF rows only (same split as DP1; validation-only application)

end_of_oof_window.state_basis: as-of-each-player's-last-active-day (lazy; phi NOT inflated to window end)

end_of_validation_window.state_basis: as-of-each-player's-last-active-day (lazy; phi NOT inflated to window end)

oof_window.description: per predicted-p_a decile band: band-mean observed win frequency vs band-mean of per-match interval_bounds(delta, s) [lower, upper]; NOT a formal coverage guarantee (intervals are per-match, this reports a band-aggregate consistency check only); no pass/fail threshold is asserted

validation_window.description: per predicted-p_a decile band: band-mean observed win frequency vs band-mean of per-match interval_bounds(delta, s) [lower, upper]; NOT a formal coverage guarantee (intervals are per-match, this reports a band-aggregate consistency check only); no pass/fail threshold is asserted

f2_v1_calibrated_validation_only.evidence_role: CALIBRATED_HONEST (affine fitted on F2 OOF-window predictions only, strictly before the validation block; same split as DP1)
f2_v1_calibrated_validation_only.oof_omitted: QUARANTINED_NOT_PRODUCED (no row-time-valid cheap reproduction of the outer-fold F2 calibration exists; omitted rather than faked)

oof_raw_dp1_minus_f2.label: OOF: DP1 raw - F2 raw
oof_raw_dp1_minus_f2.note: left minus right; negative favours left

validation_calibrated_dp1_minus_f2.label: VAL: DP1 cal - F2 cal (both affines frozen-from-own-OOF, applied forward only)
validation_calibrated_dp1_minus_f2.note: left minus right; negative favours left

validation_raw_dp1_minus_f2.label: VAL: DP1 raw - F2 raw
validation_raw_dp1_minus_f2.note: left minus right; negative favours left

universe.universe_accounting_note: dev_window_races = orchestrator oof_scored + orchestrator_exclusions (enforced inside cross_fit itself, SPEC-031). validation_window_races are ALL scored by the hand-rolled prequential replay/update (no fit-failure refusal path exists in an online incremental rating update); no validation-window exclusions are expected or produced.
